title: Practical Data Python
description: Build the Python toolkit data engineers and analysts use before pandas even enters the picture — parsing CSVs and JSON logs, working with datetimes, grouping with defaultdict, and processing large files in memory-safe chunks.
outcomes: You'll parse CSV files with DictReader, load and filter JSON logs, convert date strings with strptime, group records with defaultdict, process large iterables in bounded-memory chunks, and write clean Python pipelines for real data-engineering tasks.
